brief:
Settlers attacked residents of Hamroush in Saʿir village north of Hebra, with footage documenting the assault, the Ma'an news agency reported. The video evidence captures the confrontation between Israeli settlers and Palestinian civilians in the occupied West Bank community.

The incident is among recurring reports of settler violence against Palestinian residents in areas of the West Bank. Such attacks have persisted despite international concern over the security situation facing Palestinian communities. The specific circumstances of the assault and any resulting injuries were not detailed in the agency's initial report.
title: Video documents settler attack on residents in northern Hebron village
